fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: Slides an arm through the gaps in the target's guard, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Shield-Wall Shove
fusions.desc: Thrusts a plate outward on every arm, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Closing Bulwark
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Bucklers
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
